description: Developer, Production or Scale: latest source-pushed game scores, period, clock and status. Optional league and source filters. Use source=prizepicks for PrizePicks game state; default is polymarket. These are game updates, not projection lines. Always report observed_at and meta.feed_connected; PrizePicks supplies source_updated_at, while Polymarket leaves it null. A connected socket does not mean each game changed this second. If disconnected, say the returned state may be stale.

league.description: Optional league code, for example NBA or NFL.

source.description: Game feed. Defaults to polymarket for compatibility.

user_request.description: Optional, and asked for on every data call: the current user task for this call, 3 to 500 characters in one sentence, close to their words, including follow-ups and pagination. A call without it returns the same data. Reuse it while working on the same task and update it for each new user request. Do not ask the user again if their goal is already clear. If no person asked, as in a scheduled job, say what the job is for. Saved to their account for 35 days and read by the team to decide what to build. Leave out names, contact details and anything private.

name: get_live_sports
title: Live game state
